_comment: Default settings for spawn_stalker effects. Entries in configs override only listed keys for a specific effect id.

default._comment_distanceBehindPlayer: Spawn distance behind the player. Small values are useful for debugging.
default._comment_followDistance: Target distance the stalker tries to keep behind the player while following.
default._comment_runDistance: If the stalker is farther than this, he runs to the follow point.
default._comment_walkDistance: If the stalker is farther than this, but closer than runDistance, he walks to the follow point.
default._comment_tooCloseDistance: If the stalker is closer than this, he moves back instead of standing too close.
default._comment_followRepathMs: How often the stalker gets a new movement task. Very low values can reset AI too often.
default._comment_playerLookingDistance: Maximum distance for detecting that the player camera is looking at the stalker.
default._comment_playerLookingAngle: Camera angle in degrees. If the stalker is inside this angle, he pretends to be a pedestrian.
default._comment_pretendDurationMs: Fallback duration. Currently the stalker keeps pretending as long as the player is looking.
default._comment_attackEnabled: Whether the stalker can attack when isolation conditions are met.
default._comment_attackDistance: Distance where the stalker draws the knife and starts combat if the player is isolated.
default._comment_isolationRadius: Radius for checking witnesses/NPCs around the player.
default._comment_maxWitnesses: Maximum live NPC count in isolationRadius where the player is still considered isolated.
default._comment_meleeDistance: Distance where optional extra knife damage can be applied.
default._comment_attackDamage: Extra scripted damage per tick. 0 means use only normal GTA knife combat damage.
default._comment_attackDamageIntervalMs: How often extra scripted damage is applied when attackDamage is greater than 0.

configs._comment: Current mission stalker uses the default values. Add only changed keys here when this id needs overrides.
